result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. I only compiled the `reports` module (it succeeds). I ran no tests and did not try a renamed config.

The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, in the zip-building block of the export. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects. For each aspect it builds the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that names the loose text files, and reads that file for the zip entry.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` step comes after the `all_files.zip` write in the same try block, so it is written again too.
